target_format: 24 English BIP39-listed words with invalid checksum; PBKDF2 mnemonic salt, empty passphrase, BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0

derivation.summary: Recovered phrase derives the funded native SegWit address at BIP84 account 0, receiving index 0. It fails the BIP39 checksum, so the oracle derives 24 English word-list entries without enforcing that checksum.
derivation.certified_against: Public BIP84 vector plus independently calculated valid/invalid 24-word regression addresses; actual target independently reproduced with manual BIP32, secp256k1 and Bech32.

difficulty_note: solved by a reader (rabbidbird) after publication, not by me; the winning 24-word phrase fails the BIP39 checksum, so every checksum-filtered sweep, mine included, had discarded it
